Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.description: Saved intercompany reconciliation state (companies, movements, difference comments, and active period) for cloud persistence and shareable viewing.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reconciliation owner

ownerName.description: Display name of the user who saved the reconciliation

title.description: Descriptive title of the saved reconciliation

entities.description: Ordered list of companies feeding the reconciliation matrices

movements.description: Intercompany CXC and CXP movement items

comments.description: Map of pair IDs to editable difference explanations

closedMonths.description: Map of closed month keys to immutable closure metadata and snapshots

entitiesCount.description: Total number of configured companies saved

ClosedPeriod.title: ClosedPeriod
ClosedPeriod.description: Immutable permanent archive of a closed monthly reconciliation.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who closed the period

ownerName.description: Display name of the user who closed the period

title.description: Title of the closed reconciliation period

entities.description: Frozen list of companies at the time of closing

movements.description: Frozen list of monthly movements at the time of closing

comments.description: Frozen map of difference comments at the time of closing

movementsCount.description: Number of movements in the closed month

differencesCount.description: Number of pending differences at closure

closedAtIso.description: ISO timestamp when the month was closed

CompanyDirectory.title: CompanyDirectory
CompanyDirectory.description: Independent master catalog of companies (name, NIT, contact email, code, country, currency, matrix order) per scope, editable regardless of closed reconciliation months.

entitiesCount.description: Total number of companies in the directory

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the last user who updated the company directory

updatedByName.description: Display name of the last user who updated the company directory

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial directory creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last directory update

BankReconciliation.title: BankReconciliation
BankReconciliation.description: Saved corporate bank reconciliation workspace containing bank accounts, statement movements, book ledger entries, and match groups.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the bank reconciliation owner

ownerName.description: Display name of the user who saved the bank reconciliation

title.description: Descriptive title of the bank reconciliation workspace

openPeriod.description: Active open reconciliation period label, or empty string when closed and awaiting a new reconciliation opening

closedReconciliations.description: Bounded archive (max 60) of closed monthly bank reconciliation snapshots including frozen societies, accounts, SAP 00/01/02 balances, and FBL3N open items

societies.description: Catalog of SAP corporate societies (codigoSociedad, nombre, pais, moneda, nit) configured for bank treasury reconciliations

accounts.description: List of corporate bank accounts including SAP 00/01/02 GL accounts (cuentaMayor00/01/02, raizContable, saldoCuenta00/01/02), product description (productoCuenta), accounting/NIT code (codigoContable), cutoff date, and per-month accounting vs bank balances (saldosPorMes)

sapOpenItems.description: SAP FBL3N open items (doc class CB/DZ/AB/KZ/KR/DC, subaccount 00/01/02, signed local amount, automatic and manual deliverable classification)

sapBalanceRows.description: Raw SAP balance trial rows loaded for subaccounts 00, 01, and 02 grouped by society and accounting root

statementItems.description: Bank statement movements and direct reconciling items affecting Accounting Books (MAS Notas Débito no Contabilizadas / MENOS Notas Crédito no Contabilizadas)

ledgerItems.description: Accounting bank ledger entries and direct reconciling items affecting Bank Statement (MENOS Cheques Pendientes / MAS Consignaciones Pendientes)

matches.description: Reconciled match groups linking bank statement and book ledger items

UserPermission.title: UserPermission
UserPermission.description: Email-keyed RBAC access record defining a user's corporate role (admin, operador, consulta), authorized modules, and permitted companies across all modules.

displayName.description: User full name or position label

allowedModules.description: List of suite module identifiers accessible to this user

companyScope.description: Whether the user can view all companies or only selected companies

allowedCompanies.description: List of company/society names accessible when companyScope is selected (legacy fallback)

moduleCompanyAccess.description: Per-module company access rules mapping functional module IDs (intercompany, bancos, viaticos, anticipos, cxc, cxp) to { scope: 'all' | 'selected', companies: string[] }

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last modified this rule

AccessControlRegistry.title: AccessControlRegistry
AccessControlRegistry.description: Admin-only consolidated directory of all email permission rules stored at /app_settings/access_control.

records.description: Bounded list of UserPermission objects managed by administrators

recordsCount.description: Total number of user permission rules

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last updated the registry

AccessPolicy.title: AccessPolicy
AccessPolicy.description: Non-PII global access policy flag (strict allowlist enforcement) stored at /app_settings/policy.

strictMode.description: When true, authenticated emails not listed in user_permissions are denied access

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last updated policy

ViaticosWorkspace.title: ViaticosWorkspace
ViaticosWorkspace.description: Corporate travel expense settlements (Liquidación de Viáticos) workspace containing consultants directory and expense liquidations without raw media binaries.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace creator

ownerName.description: Display name of the last user who saved the workspace

title.description: Descriptive title of the Viáticos workspace

consultores.description: Bounded catalog of corporate consultants eligible for travel settlements including assigned cost center (centroCosto)

liquidaciones.description: Bounded list of weekly travel expense settlements, cost center snapshots, and line items

ModuleCompanyDirectory.title: ModuleCompanyDirectory
ModuleCompanyDirectory.description: Independent master database of companies/societies dedicated to a specific functional module (bancos, viaticos, anticipos, cxc, cxp), containing no personal PII.

companies.description: Bounded catalog of corporate societies/companies belonging exclusively to this module

companiesCount.description: Total number of companies registered in this module database

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last updated this module database

updatedByName.description: Display name of the administrator who last updated this module database

/reconciliations/{reconciliationId}.description: Stores saved intercompany reconciliations that can be updated by their owner, operators, or admins and viewed via a shared link.

/closed_periods/{archiveId}.description: Stores permanent, append-only immutable archives of closed monthly reconciliations.

/company_directories/{scopeId}.description: Stores independent company directories per scope (internacionales, nacionales, anitox) editable independently of closed months.

/bank_reconciliations/{bankRecId}.description: Stores saved corporate bank reconciliation workspaces including accounts, bank statements, accounting ledgers, and match records.

/user_permissions/{emailDocId}.description: Stores per-email RBAC permissions (role, allowed modules, allowed companies). Readable only by the matching verified user or an administrator; writable only by administrators.

/app_settings/{settingId}.description: Split configuration collection: 'policy' stores non-PII strictMode flag readable by signed-in users; 'access_control' stores the admin-only user permission directory.

/viaticos_workspaces/{viaticosId}.description: Stores corporate travel expense settlements (Liquidación de Viáticos) and consultants catalog; readable only by verified users authorized for viaticos.

/module_company_directories/{moduleId}.description: Stores independent master company/society catalogs for each functional module (bancos, viaticos, anticipos, cxc, cxp); readable by verified users and writable strictly by verified administrators.
